documents.author: user-001
documents.content:
# PRD v1 — Core Task Management

**Status:** Approved
**Author:** Alex Chen

---

## Overview

The foundational feature of PRendgame: a kanban-style task board embedded in the VS Code sidebar/panel.

## Goals

1. Engineers can see and manage their tasks without opening a browser
2. PMs can create and prioritize tasks in the same tool engineers use
3. Task state is visible to AI agents via API/MCP

## Requirements

### Board View (Kanban)
- Default columns: Backlog, To Do, In Progress, In Review, Done
- Customizable columns per project
- Drag-and-drop between columns
- Filter by: assignee, label, priority, sprint

### Task Card
- Title, description (markdown), assignee, priority, labels
- Sprint assignment, linked documents, linked code
- Comments thread, activity log

## Architecture

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[User drags card] --> B[Webview postMessage]
    B --> C[Extension Host]
    C --> D[TaskService.updateStatus]
    D --> E[Local Store]
    E --> F[SyncService.push]
    F --> G[Broadcast to webviews]
```

## Non-Goals
- Time tracking
- Gantt charts (deferred to timeline view)
- Burndown charts (deferred to v2)

# PRD v2 — Documentation & Diagrams

**Status:** Draft
**Author:** Alex Chen

---

## Overview

Embed a rich document editor inside PRendgame for PRDs, specs, and meeting notes.

## Goals

1. PMs can author requirements without leaving the IDE
2. Documents are first-class objects linked to tasks and code
3. AI agents can read documents to understand context

## Document Types

| Type | Template |
|------|----------|
| PRD | Overview, Goals, Requirements, Non-Goals |
| User Story | Persona, Action, Outcome, Acceptance Criteria |
| Technical Spec | Context, Approach, API, Data Model, Risks |
| Meeting Notes | Date, Attendees, Decisions, Action Items |
| ADR | Status, Context, Decision, Consequences |

documents.title: PRD v3 — AI-Native Integration (MCP)
documents.author: user-001
documents.content:
# PRD v3 — AI-Native Integration

**Status:** Draft

## Overview

PRendgame is NOT an AI agent. It is the project context layer that AI agents plug into via MCP and REST API.

## MCP Tools

```
prendgame.tasks.list
prendgame.tasks.get
prendgame.tasks.create
prendgame.tasks.update
prendgame.tasks.transition
prendgame.docs.list
prendgame.docs.get
prendgame.sprint.current
prendgame.board.snapshot
```

## Example: Agent reads PRD, implements feature
1. Engineer types "implement this" in their AI chat
2. Agent calls prendgame.tasks.get to read task + linked PRD
3. Agent writes code using acceptance criteria
4. Agent calls prendgame.tasks.transition to move task to In Review

# PRD v4 — Cloud Sync & Collaboration

**Status:** Draft

## Overview

Supabase-backed cloud sync for team collaboration. Free tier is local-only; paid tier adds sync.

## Data Model

```mermaid
erDiagram

    PROJECT ||--o{ DOCUMENT : has
    PROJECT ||--o{ SPRINT : has

    USER ||--o{ TASK : assigned_to
```

documents.title: Technical Spec — Authentication Architecture
documents.author: user-003
documents.content:
# Technical Spec — Authentication

## Approach
Supabase Auth with email/password + GitHub OAuth.

## Flow
1. User clicks 'Sign In' in status bar
2. Extension opens browser for Supabase OAuth
3. Redirect back to prendgame:// protocol handler
4. Token stored in VS Code SecretStorage
5. SyncService uses token for Supabase client
